title: DEEP PARITY & DISPATCH AUDIT — Simulator = Web Chat = WhatsApp (read-only, no implementation)
description: Evidence-based deep parity and dispatch audit across the three channels (Simulator, Web Chat, WhatsApp). Mandatory investigation of the incident: "User asked Clean Nails → MIA sent Neurotin content/media". LOOP RULE: NO IMPLEMENTATION. No functional code, DB, prompt, catalog, knowledge, MIA Lab, dispatch, WhatsApp, Web Chat, Simulator, deploy, or implementation commits. Only allowed artifacts: audit/governance/workshop documents. END STATE: STOP_FOR_HUMAN. This is a research/traceability/evidence/classification/proposal mission only, ending in MISSION_COMPLETE then STOP_FOR_HUMAN for debate before any implementation. E2E B-G officially paused during this audit.
